⚽ Rocket-powered car soccer! Boost, jump, FLY through the air and smash the ball into the net. You're on the pitch within seconds.

🏆 RANKED – climb from Iron to Champion and chase the Celestial top 100
👥 PARTIES – squad up with your friends and queue together
🎯 FREEPLAY & BOTS – practice aerials, flips and wall shots
📊 LEADERBOARDS – climb the global and friends boards
🎨 CUSTOMIZE – cars, paints, wheels, boosts, trails and epic goal explosions
🎟️ KICKOFF PASS – a full season of rewards to unlock
💬 QUICK CHAT – "Nice shot!" in two taps

✅ Fair play: cosmetics never change how your car drives.
📱💻🎮 Phone, tablet, PC or controller – everyone plays together.
